outcome: Surgical closure of patent ductus arteriosus (PDA)
cohort: The study included 494 infants delivered from 410 women, comprising 320 single gestations and 174 multiple gestations, born between 2015 and 2016 at 11 level III perinatal centers.
finding: The study found no significant difference in neonatal morbidity and mortality between very premature infants resulting from single and multiple gestations after adjusting for gestational age and confounding variables.
